div.div:
Why chunk at all?
Semantic search needs pieces small enough to be individually relevant. A whole 1000-page book is one useless match.

div.div:
Same model, both sides.
Documents and queries must be embedded by the same model, or the vectors live in different spaces and the distances mean nothing.

div.div:
The LLM was never retrained.
It answers a private-data question purely because the right pages were placed in front of it at query time.
